topics: Advance RM-011 from planned to in_progress and implement P2-011A only; keep RM-011 incomplete and P2-011B unapproved and not started.
Implement a strict versioned budget schema, explicit v1 migration, fake monotonic clock, serial usage accounting, retry classification, and typed budget failures.

Distinguish timed_out, cancel_requested, cancel_unconfirmed, and cancelled without claiming cooperative thread cancellation is a hard stop.
Preserve P2-010A phase contracts, P2-024A context envelopes, public APIs, CLI behavior, artifact meanings, and calculator ToolResult metadata.
Do not add dependencies, external providers, external solvers, runtime bridges, durable manifests, transactions, reservations, CAS, resume accounting, approval CAS, retention, or cleanup.
Update roadmap state and evidence append-only; stop for a new approval and digest before changing immutable scope, dependencies, or approved policy decisions.
Keep intermediate data, review logs, test output, run artifacts, and user_materials out of Git.

milestone_contract.scope: Strict budget schema, fake clock, serial accounting, and retry classification.

acceptance_criteria: Unknown, zero, or over-cap cost prevents external calls while free local execution remains valid; retries are typed and idempotent; unconfirmed cancellation is not success.
item_contract.objective: Make every active budget field finite, enforceable, auditable, and fail-closed or remove it from active configuration.
item_contract.title: Budget, retry, timeout, cancellation, and concurrency semantics

acceptance_criteria: BudgetPolicyV2, BudgetSnapshot, UsageDelta, SerialUsageLedger, retry and deadline/cancellation values, typed failures, deterministic canonical hashes, and explicit v1 migration are strict and versioned.
Boolean, coercive string, non-finite, negative, unknown-field, clock-rollback, policy-substitution, unsupported-concurrency, and malformed-usage inputs fail closed.
External costs use integer micro-USD; unknown, disabled, and over-cap external attempts are refused before analyze while local-free provider and calculator execution remain valid at cap zero.
Legacy max_output_bytes expands once during v1 migration into separate provider-output, tool-input, tool-output, and artifact UTF-8 byte limits; max_run_bytes remains fail closed.

Active runtime is measured serially with an injected monotonic clock and excludes human approval wait; accounting remains attempt/run-local without durable reservation, manifest, transaction, CAS, or resume integration.
Retry classification is separate from execution, exposes at most N+1 candidate attempts for N retries, and never performs automatic retries in P2-011A.
Typed deadline and cancellation distinguish timed out, requested, unconfirmed, and acknowledged states; uncooperative in-process work is not reported as hard-stopped or successful.

P2-010A phase behavior, P2-024A ContextEnvelope checks, serial call and artifact order, run/resume/show, CLI exits, public schemas, and calculator ToolResult metadata remain compatible with no new dependency.

items.title: Context lifecycle contract
items.objective: Implement the approved P2-024A attempt-scoped context policy, immutable envelope, lineage, expiry, integrity, and provider allowlist contract without persistence, cleanup, external runtime, or later Phase 2 work.
acceptance_criteria: A strict versioned immutable ContextPolicy and ContextEnvelope bind classification, retention-policy ID, UTC expiry, exact allowlist, canonical payload/source/policy hashes, and run/assignment/attempt/runtime lineage.

The actual orchestrator-to-provider path validates integrity, expiry, lineage, runtime, assignment allowlist parity, restricted secrets, and provider availability before delivering a fresh AgentContext copy.

Unknown fields, versions, runtimes, dotted-path allowlists, tampering, replay, expired context, and restricted provider handoff fail closed without enabling external providers or writing context lifecycle state.
Existing AgentContext and provider signatures, LocalProvider behavior, CLI exit codes, run/resume/show, and existing artifact meanings remain compatible.
Unit, property/metamorphic, integration, adversarial, CLI, roadmap, doctor, and canonical quality gates pass with no new dependency.

topics: Implement RM-024 milestone P2-024A only.
Use context classifications public, internal by default, sensitive, and restricted.
Treat secrets and credentials as restricted; reject provider handoff fail closed and never use redaction as authorization.
Create a fresh immutable ContextEnvelope for every attempt.
Do not add persistence, automatic deletion, or a cleanup executor in P2-024A.
Require explicit policy expiry, timezone-aware UTC, an injected clock, and reject use when now is at or after expires_at.
Defer concrete retention durations, quarantine, deletion, tombstones, and secure erase to RM-027A/B.
Bind schema version, context, run, assignment, attempt, parent context, source hash, producer runtime, and consumer runtime lineage.
Support Python local runtime only and reject Codex bridge, unknown runtime, and unknown schema versions fail closed.
Preserve AgentContext, provider, CLI, run/resume/show, and artifact compatibility; keep P2-024A as additive internal API.
Do not implement external providers, solvers, dependencies, RM-010 through RM-013, RM-027 cleanup, or parallel execution.
